notes: CHG-004 approved by the Product Owner on 2026-09-09. DATA-005 amended to exempt exactly one named address; UT-013 written to keep the exemption from widening.

UT-013 failed on its first run and found a pre-existing DATA-005 violation the approval instruction explicitly forbids: 25 generated contact addresses, the account book's mainEmail and website, and the second workspace administrator were all on live-looking domains built from company names plus .ae. CL-007 had been recorded as resolved by moving everything to a reserved domain; it had only ever been applied to the ten persona logins. Recorded as CONV-010 and repaired.

Second defect found: --reset drops only the primary demo tenant, so the second workspace survives a reset. Renaming its administrator therefore created a duplicate that collided on EmployeeProfile.employeeNumber. Recorded as CONV-011, worked around locally by deleting the stale tenant; not fixed, because extending the reset is a requirement question about FR-011 and FR-012.

The temporary preview tunnel is an operational measure, not part of this specification. SPEC-0008 remains READY_FOR_APPROVAL and owns the permanent demo environment; nothing here was deployed, pushed or merged.
